Title: Taking about your cards (Mostly to LSJ)

Messages.Author: Jesper Bøje
Messages.Body:
Hi there

after a very heated discussion on a danish newgroupe about telling others
what cards you have on your hand I wish to know if there are any rules for
or against this?!?

/Jesper

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Table talk (including stating the contents of your hand - including
also lying about the contents of your hand) is allowed.

Showing the cards in your hand to other players is not allowed (unless
a game effect causes it).

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>> after a very heated discussion on a danish newgroupe about telling others
>> what cards you have on your hand I wish to know if there are any rules for
>> or against this?!?
>
>Table talk (including stating the contents of your hand - including
>also lying about the contents of your hand) is allowed.
>
>Showing the cards in your hand to other players is not allowed (unless
>a game effect causes it).

Yeah. You can tell people about your hand but you can't actually show it to
them.

Similarly, with cards that let you look at other people's hands (i.e.
Revelations, Pulse of the Canaille), you aren't allowed to show your prey's
hand to everyone else, but there's nothing to prevent you from telling everyone
else what your prey has. Though then they have to consider whether or not to
trust what you say...

Halcyan 2
